tools.name: surfacedby_inspect_page_evidence
tools.description: Read up to five public pages, without running JavaScript, and return their sections, tables, links and structured data, each with its source, to check buyer information, compare offers and confirm claims. Also lists technical notes, structured data that repeats across pages, and how many requests remain. Judge the notes in the user's context; they are not automatically problems. Pages that could only be read in part, or not at all, are marked. Runs no AI queries and does not check AI visibility.

tools.name: surfacedby_analyze_answer_evidence
tools.description: Check an AI answer the user pastes in: which businesses it names and which sources it links. Sorts the linked sources by type and follows Google and Gemini redirect links where supported, within the request limit. The result describes this one answer only, not whether it is accurate or how visible a business is in general, and copying an answer can drop its links. To check whether its claims are true, also inspect the pages, and say clearly that the result is about the pasted answer. Runs no AI queries and cannot tell why a model included or left out a business.

tools.name: surfacedby_check_ai_crawler_access
tools.description: Check which AI crawlers a site allows, limits or blocks in robots.txt, what that means for each AI platform and the search index it uses, where to submit pages, whether a security check blocks an ordinary visit, homepage noindex, llms.txt and Content-Signal, with fixes ready to copy. Reads the site's public files and makes one ordinary page request, so firewall rules aimed at crawlers' own IP addresses do not show up here.

tools.name: surfacedby_get_ai_source_landscape
tools.description: For each AI platform, the mix of source types it cites, recent changes in which sources it cites, and how its answers cite, from SurfacedBy's published AI Search Index, with the data date, the public page and related research with links. Figures are pooled across many brands: they describe each platform, not any one business.

tools.name: surfacedby_plan_ai_visibility_audit
tools.description: The step-by-step checklist for an AI visibility audit of a business website: each step, the tools to use, what a good result looks like, the rules to follow, the SurfacedBy research that applies to the goal, and how many requests remain. Makes no request to the website.
